BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fiscal note instructions; adding a new sectionto chapter 43.88A RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that some economicdevelopment initiatives, including tax incentives and infrastructurefinance, have the potential for a positive fiscal impact on the statethat is not always reflected in the fiscal notes prepared by stateagencies. It is the intent of this legislation to modify theprocedures employed in the preparation of fiscal notes to betterreflect the potential for increased revenue from economic developmentinitiatives.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.88A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The fiscal note instructions issued by the office of financialmanagement as required by RCW 43.88A.020 shall include procedures, suchas economic projections or modeling, that take into account increased p. 1 SB 6374economic activity which may result from any economic developmentcontemplated in a bill or resolution.
